# Locus demographic profiles

Reference year and boundary edition: Census 2021 / ASGS Edition 3 (2021). Profiles are direct published SAL and SA4 aggregates, with no 2026-area redistribution.

Source: ABS 2021 Census General Community Profile national DataPacks, retrieved 5 November 2026. Selected tables: G01 (population, coarse age bands, sex and Australian citizen count); G08 (ancestry); G09 (country of birth); G16 (highest school year); G33 (weekly household income); G49 (highest non-school qualification level).

Every profile records its official geography code/name, table, source link, universe, denominator, source fields and relevant notes. Missing or zero denominators must not produce fabricated percentages. Counts are official published values, with independently adjusted cells that may not add exactly to totals.

Ancestry is multiple response and uses the published total-persons row for percentages. Education is presented in two different universes: G16 excludes current primary/secondary school attendees; G49 includes only people aged 15+ with non-school qualifications. Household income uses occupied private dwellings excluding visitor-only/other non-classifiable households. These denominators must never be replaced by total population. Australian citizenship is a one-category observed count from G01; no non-citizen or not-stated counts are inferred.

The map display geometry is supplied separately and must match 2021. A current (2026) locality code is not used as evidence of a 2021 geography match. Special nonspatial records remain in reference metadata and should not be plotted as physical areas.

Based on Australian Bureau of Statistics data. ABS data used with permission from the Australian Bureau of Statistics. DataPacks are supplied under CC BY 4.0; the packaged source readme, metadata and original source links are retained in the acquisition archive.

Official source: https://www.abs.gov.au/census/find-census-data/datapacks
